text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: One day, a letter from a fan arrives for<n>Rice Shower.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her expression slips from one of<n>happiness to one
of slight unease.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, I get this idea in my<n>head...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What if cheering for me brings my<n>fans misfortune?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I don't want to think so negatively,<n>but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Why don't you read the letter first?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
choice_data_list: Why don't you read the letter first?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I get so much courage from seeing<n>you racing with
all your might.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And when I see you smile, I always<n>feel warm
inside.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Racing with all my might... My smile...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...I see. I'm not doing anything<n>special, but that still
makes them<n>happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... I want to work even<n>harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... I want to work even<n>harder!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want to bring happiness to the<n>people who
support me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The clouds of doubt disappear from<n>Rice Shower's
eyes, replaced by a<n>blazing light!
